experiment: C28 = Curriculum Curvature Schedule (C27) + M3 Cross-Layer Transport
hypothesis: 在 C27 (curriculum c 0.05→1.0) 基础上启用 M3 cross-layer transport_between — curriculum 期间 c 变化时, M3 保持跨层 residual 几何一致 (tangent space transport 防几何失配). M2 intrinsic Möbius 减法保持关闭 (M2 是 residual 减法, 与 M3 transport 互斥, 任选其一).

gate_1_stage2_retrain.details: 100k steps 完成 (420.2s). curriculum c 0.05→1.0 + M3 transport enable. final loss rl=0.90. codebook usage 62/231/233 (L0 略差于 C27 的 80 但 L1/L2 相当).

gate_2_sid_inference.details: 9922 SIDs 导出. 63/256/255 codes per layer → 4.11M unique SIDs.

gate_3_stage3_retrain.details: Stage3 early stop @ epoch 69, best valid ndcg@20=0.0969 (epoch 48). 比 C27 (0.0977) 略低但 test 表现更好.

gate_4_test_eval.details: test R@10=0.0991 > C27 0.0973 > baseline 0.0967. Δ vs baseline = +0.0024 (新最佳).

r37_reason: C28 test R@10=0.0991 > C27 best 0.0973 → commit + push 保留. 新 lineage 最佳成绩.
scientific_finding: M3 cross-layer transport 与 curriculum curvature 协同有效. 即使 L0 codebook collapse 略增 (62 vs C27 80), residual 在跨 c 层之间保持几何一致让 decoder 学到更鲁棒的 SIDs. Curriculum+M3 是有效的曲率机制创新路径. 距 0.11+ 还差 0.0109 (10.91% gap).
next_direction: C29 = C28 (Curriculum+M3) + 启用 M2 intrinsic Möbius 减法 (M2 + M3 联合). 或 C29 = C28 + Sinkhorn sk_eps curriculum (双 curriculum: c 和 sk_eps 同时 ramp). 探索更激进的曲率机制以达到 0.11+.
